The code "x = 1" has 5 characters.
Padding is `(1, 3)`, so `left=3`, `right=3`.
Total width for that line should be `3 + 5 + 3 = 11`.
But the `console` width is 20.
The `Padding` class by default has `expand=True`.
If `expand=True`, it will expand to fill the width.
So the line "   x = 1            " has 3 spaces on the left, "x = 1" (5 chars), and then it's padded to 20.
`20 - 3 - 5 = 12` spaces on the right.
`3 + 5 + 12 = 20`.
Wait, the assert says:
`"                    \n   x = 1            \n                    \n"`
The first line is 20 spaces.
The second line is 3 spaces + "x = 1" (5 chars) + 12 spaces = 20 characters.
The third line is 20 spaces.

This seems correct for `expand=True`.
